in_hebrew.name: Amandy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amandy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English ‘amand’ meaning ‘beloved’. This sweet and endearing name was popularized by the medieval poet, Geoffrey Chaucer, who featured a character named Amantia in his work.

in_latin.name: Amandy
in_latin.long_meaning: Amandy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English ‘amand’ meaning ‘beloved’. This sweet and endearing name was popularized by the medieval poet, Geoffrey Chaucer, who featured a character named Amantia in his work.
